nodes.title: Charging port
nodes.summary: Where the charging cable connects. AC charging passes through the on-board charger; DC fast charging feeds the battery more directly.

nodes.title: Battery pack
nodes.summary: Hundreds of cells store energy as DC electricity. A battery management system watches temperature and voltage.

nodes.title: Inverter
nodes.summary: Converts DC from the battery into controlled AC for the motor, and back again during regeneration.

nodes.title: Electric motor
nodes.summary: Turns electrical energy into rotation through magnetic fields, with strong torque from a standstill.

nodes.title: Wheels
nodes.summary: A single-speed reduction gear passes the motor's rotation to the wheels.

modes.title: Driving
modes.textAlternative: While driving, energy flows from the battery pack as DC electricity to the inverter, which converts it to AC for the electric motor. The motor turns the wheels through a reduction gear.

modes.title: Regenerative braking
modes.textAlternative: When slowing down, the turning wheels drive the motor as a generator. The inverter converts its AC output to DC and returns energy to the battery.

modes.title: Charging
modes.textAlternative: When plugged in, electricity flows from the charging port into the battery pack. AC is converted to DC by the on-board charger; DC fast charging supplies DC directly.
